label: 2 weeks
what_was_shown: A coating kept under the skin of rats for two weeks still repelled S. aureus in a fresh challenge.

label: 3 weeks
what_was_shown: Coated silicone kept its low friction after three weeks in mice.

label: 4 weeks
what_was_shown: Coated human cochlear implant arrays showed no delamination after four weeks in a sheep cochlea, and every array kept working.

label: 6 weeks
what_was_shown: The scar capsule around coated silicone was about 75 percent thinner than around uncoated silicone after six weeks in rats.

label: 6 months
what_was_shown: Coated silicone still turned away fibroblasts after six months in mice, and the film was still in place.

label: 6 months
what_was_shown: Coated silicone films were intact, with little to no delamination, after six months in mice.

label: 1 year
what_was_shown: On human cochlear implant arrays kept for one year in mice, the film was intact and the scar capsule was about 60 percent thinner.
